Subject: Post-call: security kickoff & SIG next steps (SOC2 / HIPAA / questionnaire)

Hi Alex & Lisa,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and suggested next steps to get the security intake moving: 

- High-level asks we heard: SOC 2 posture, HIPAA coverage for PHI, data residency requirements, and whether we should start with SIG (our preference) or CAIQ/custom questionnaire.
- You indicated Meditech intends to handle PHI in production and will require a BAA — we can proceed down that path.
- Next step: start a SIG prefill so we can triage the minimal evidence set and unblock procurement.

Action items I propose (please confirm):
1) We (Redwood) kick off an initial SIG-Lite prefill and provide an evidence checklist for your security team (attached).
2) Meditech confirms whether any EU data residency requirements apply and who on your side will own the SIG completion (security or procurement).
3) Schedule a short security kickoff (30m) to walk the prefills and map ownership.

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Initiation_Guide.pdf (short how-to), SIG-prefill-template.xlsx (prefill CSV you can return).

Proposed kickoff: Mon 16 Nov, 2026 at 15:00 PT — does that work for you?

I copied Ben (technical lead) to help with the evidence mapping; he can take the technical follow-ups.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova

Subject: Re: Post-call: security kickoff & SIG next steps (SOC2 / HIPAA / questionnaire)

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type I from 2025; Type II is currently in progress and expected Q2 2027. We can share the Type I report and the control descriptions now.
- HIPAA: yes, Meditech will require a BAA for any PHI processing. Procurement will need a redlineable BAA; happy to get that started once we have Redwood's standard form.
- Questionnaire preference: Security would prefer SIG (we use the SIG baseline internally), but procurement often insists on either SIG or a CAIQ + a short custom appendix. If Redwood can lead the SIG prefill that would speed things up.

Two quick technical asks before kickoff: 
1) What is Redwood's default logs retention and do you support pushing syslog / event streams to a customer's SIEM?
2) How long are model inference results retained (we need an answer for data residency & retention policy).

I've attached our Vendor_Risk_Expectations.pdf to show what procurement typically wants.

We can do Mon 16 Nov 15:00 PT — that works. I can loop our security lead if needed (TBD, likely Lisa).

Best,
Alex

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dorr <alex.dorr@meditech.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@meditech.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: security kickoff & SIG next steps (SOC2 / HIPAA / questionnaire)

Alex — thanks for the detail. Quick answers to the technical asks and our recommended evidence path: 

- Logs / SIEM: Redwood supports sending audit logs to a customer's external SIEM via secure delivery (S3 + transfer, or syslog/forwarder integrations for enterprise customers). We can include that in the architecture diagram and ops runbook.
- Inference/result retention: by default Redwood retains request/response metadata for 30 days; full content retention is configurable and can be disabled or set to a customer-defined TTL for Dedicated/Private deployments. We can provide a retention SLA in the BAA/contract.

Initial evidence checklist (suggested minimal set to unblock procurement):
- SOC 2 report (Type I now, Type II in flight)
- Encryption at rest / in transit description (KMS integration)
- Data flow diagram (we will provide)
- Access control matrix + MFA enforcement
- Penetration test / vulnerability assessment summary (most recent)
- BAA template (we can share ours)

To speed things up, we recommend starting with a SIG-Lite prefill (we will fill the obvious fields and call out definitive evidence). If procurement still requires CAIQ, we can map answers.

Attaching a compact initial-evidence-checklist.txt (one-pager) with owners and expected delivery windows. I (Ben) will be the technical point for the kickoff. If you want a security SME on the call, I can ask Aditya to join for deeper infra questions.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Subject: Re: Post-call: security kickoff & SIG next steps (SOC2 / HIPAA / questionnaire)

Thanks Ben — that all makes sense. A few follow-ups before the kickoff: 

1) Ownership: procurement would prefer Redwood to lead the SIG prefill; security will validate answers. If Redwood can own the initial work that will reduce back-and-forth.
2) Retention specifics: can you confirm whether the 30-day default applies to payloads containing PHI (i.e. can it be set to 0 days), and whether there is an option to purge artifacts from backups/kv-caches for Private deployments?
3) Logs: we will want the option to ingest audit events into our SIEM; please confirm event schema and delivery options in the kickoff.

We will aim to have Lisa/our security SME on the kickoff; procurement will join to discuss contractual timing.

Available: Mon 16 Nov 15:00 PT — please send an invite and agenda.

Alex
